name: ttgwiki
title: TTGWIKI
author: Teletype Games
desc: The Teletype Games wiki on DOS: browse, search and print its pages, or download them all to read offline. TTGWIKIW is the same program for Windows 95 and later.

dos.store_description: The Teletype Games wiki on DOS: browse, search and print its pages, or download them all to read offline. Needs mTCP (a packet driver and MTCPCFG).
dos.win32_store_description: TTGWIKI for Windows 95 and later: the Teletype Games wiki in a console window, with Winsock.
